pageDescription: Neon Dinner Midnight — private frontend design preview.
rendererError: Unable to display the reels. Please reload the game.
historyNote: Preview entries only. This browser tab keeps up to 200 rounds.
historyEmpty: Your completed preview spins will appear here.
rulesIntro: Five reels. Three rows. Five fixed paylines, all active on every spin. Your total bet is divided equally between the five lines.
lineWinsDescription: Matching symbols pay from left to right, starting on the first reel. Seven pays for 2–5 matching symbols; food symbols pay for 3–5.
wildRule: WILD jukebox appears on reels 2, 3 and 4. It substitutes for ordinary symbols, but not Dollar or Star.
scatterRule: Dollar pays for 3–5 symbols anywhere. Star pays for 3–5 symbols on reels 1, 3 and 5. Line and special-symbol awards are added together.
paytableNote: Multipliers apply to the bet per line. Values below reproduce the supplied rules; this preview does not evaluate payouts.
autoplayRule: Select 5, 10, 25, 50 or 100 spins. Stop Autoplay allows the current spin to finish and prevents the next spin. Balance updates when a round result is received.
connectionRule: While a round is unresolved, another bet cannot be placed. Reconnection retrieves the pending result. Autoplay stays stopped.
rulesPreviewNote: This is a frontend preview with authored outcomes and sample money. Live limits, RTP, outcomes and payouts will come from the existing backend. These rules are a design draft, not a new certification document.
autoplayNote: You can stop the series at any time. The current spin will finish.
scenarioDescription: Choose the next UI scenario. Results are scripted, independent of bet size, and do not represent game odds or payouts.
previewNote: Reloading keeps completed preview rounds in this tab. The real API is not connected.
enableJavaScript: Enable JavaScript to open the interactive preview.
invalidAmount: Enter an amount with up to two decimal places.
loadError: Unable to load your game. Please reload to try again.
connectionLost: Connection lost. Your round is pending.
roundError: Unable to confirm the round. Please contact support before trying again.
reconnectFailed: Still unable to reconnect. Please try again.
